title: knoxia glabra
intro: Knoxia glabra, commonly known as Indian spikenard or knoxia, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is a herb used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Knoxia glabra are believed to be attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
